meta.reset: Reset DB, cache and search index to `fixtures` before every case. Fixture objects are flat: one object per translation (posts: per (post_id, language); categories: per (slug, language); editors: per (slug, language)). Entity-level fields (created_at, created_by, published_at, views, author, categories on posts; hidden/navbar on categories; deleted_at on editors) are repeated identically on every row of the same entity. Actor rows are seeded by the harness (email <name>@example.com, last_login null, permissions = session mask). Inject sessions directly.
meta.actor: Key into fixtures.actors, or: anonymous (no Authorization header), garbage_session, expired_session. Actor mask = actor.permissions when non-zero, else derived from caps (posts: create/edit/delete bits; views: edit bit). Ownership of a post is decided by posts.created_by == actor username.
meta.request: path_params are unescaped and must be percent-encoded when substituted. headers: null removes a default header. body_raw (even empty string) overrides body. body_generator {json_padded_bytes: N, base} = valid JSON of exactly N bytes, padded with an unknown field.
meta.tokens: {$const: NAME} constants; {$repeat: {s, n}}; {$email_of_length: N}; {$raw_session: actor} session id without Bearer; {$actor_perms: actor} the actor's permission mask. Tokens appear only as direct field values (body, headers, path_params, assertion value).
meta.expect.body: empty | plain_text | json | any. Create (201) returns json {id, location}; update/views/delete (204) return empty.
meta.json_assertions: List of {path, op, value}. ops: eq, ne, type, len_eq, len_lte, gte, includes, excludes, is_null, not_null, unix_or_null (every element is an integer or null), sorted_asc, sorted_desc. Paths with [*] resolve to lists. is_null passes for both a missing field and an explicit null.
meta.eventually_ms: Retry the step until it passes or the timeout elapses (indexing is async).
meta.note: Free-text explanation of the assumption behind a case. Present on every case tagged `ambiguous` and on some inferred ones.
meta.semantics: The language of a translation comes only from the path (request bodies have no `language`). `slug` is mandatory on create and follows the category/editor slug rules (trim spaces/dashes/underscores, letters/digits/-/_ only, lower-cased, max 128) but is NOT unique: several posts, or translations, may share a slug. PATCH resets published_at and author when omitted or null.
meta.source: documented = rules inside the source_document; stated = rules given outside the docs (slug semantics, 406/413/415 conventions); inferred = derived from code (strings.go) or conventions.
meta.tags: boundary, cache, security, regression, verify_normalisation (needs case-folding), verify_char_counting, verify_clamp (ClampParams behaviour), assumes_distinct_bits (create/edit/delete/views are separate bits), undocumented_limit (limit comes from strings.go, not the docs), assumes_sequential_id (the case reads back a created post as id 6 = max fixture id + 1; the harness cannot capture ids), ambiguous (docs are silent/contradictory or the outcome depends on an assumption; expectation chosen by common sense, see note).
